title: Tidy tables - WM x Imagery follow-up experiment
description: Rows of trials.csv, stars.csv, probes.csv and encoding_events.csv written by scripts/csv-export.js (generator scripts/tidy-tables.js). Positions are in mm in the fixed grid frame: origin at fixation, x right, y down; x_mm / y_mm are after rotation, cell_x_mm / cell_y_mm are in the upright grid. Serial position = ordinal among ALL visible stimuli of the trial (dual 1-6, single-task 1-3, 1-based); slot_in_stream = slot in the six-slot encoding stream including invisible placeholders (1-6); test position = order of the recognition tests. Indexing: every ordinal / position / sequence column is 1-based (first = 1), including cell_row, cell_col, block_position and pool_index; the only 0-based values are the identifiers cell (0-24, centre 12) and tone_index (0-23), which are keys into src/config.js and src/grid.js, not counts (cell = (cell_row - 1) * 5 + (cell_col - 1)). Raw rows keep their recorded 0-based values. Timing: the encoding_events table gives onset, offset, duration, planned values, onset error and the silence before / after each slot, all in ms from encoding onset (tone onsets and offsets are scheduled, not measured).

trial.title: trial row
trial.description: One row per trial. Unique key: participant_id, trial_seq_session. Missing values are NA in the CSV.

participant_id.description: Participant id used in this table: a pseudonymous code ("P" + 12 hex) in the default export, never the Prolific id; the raw Prolific id only with --keep-pid. A reloaded run is suffixed __run_<run_id>.

trial_seq_session.description: Running number of trial-start gates in the session (practice included), in presentation order. Unique per participant.

trial_uid.description: Trial name from the runtime, e.g. main_a-007-i_d. Unique for main trials; practice names repeat when a practice pass is repeated.

attempt.description: Pass number of the trial: 1 for main trials, 1 or 2 for practice trials (practice can run twice).

condition.description: d_only, t_only, i_only, i_d or i_t.

presentation_index.description: 1-120, 1-based, over the main task in presentation order; empty in practice. Counted by the exporter.

presentation_index_stamped.description: Value written by the runtime, for comparison with presentation_index.

block_position.description: Position of the trial in its block in presentation order, 1-based (1 = first trial of the block). Raw: block_position, 0-based.

pool_index.description: Number of the trial in the condition pool of 24, 1-24, 1-based (raw trial_index_in_block + 1; the `Trial` column of the wide files). Not unique across conditions.

rotation_deg.description: Rotation of the grid for the trial, -90..90, clockwise positive: the angle imagined in the imagery conditions and the angle the grid is shown at in d_only. Empty for t_only.

sequence.description: Six-slot sequence, M = memory-item slot, S = star slot.

n_stars_planned.description: Stars planned for the trial (3 in imagery conditions, 0 otherwise).

n_probes_planned.description: Recognition probes planned (3 in memory conditions, 0 otherwise).

pattern_phase_before_trial.description: True if the pattern reminder was shown at the start of this trial.

trials_since_pattern_phase.description: Interval COUNT (not an ordinal position): trials since the last pattern reminder, 0 when this trial had one; empty before the first.

pattern_reminder.description: Scheduler plan: True if this trial was planned to carry the pattern reminder (only imagery trials can). Compare pattern_phase_before_trial, which records what was shown.

trials_since_pattern_reminder.description: Scheduler plan, an interval COUNT (not an ordinal position): trials since the last planned reminder (0 on the reminded trial); empty on memory-only trials and when the plan was not stamped.

rest_before_trial.description: True if a rest screen came directly before this trial.

trial_has_stars.description: True for conditions that contain stars.

n_stars_no_response.description: Stars with no response (recorded rows only).

n_stars_missing_row.description: Planned stars with no recorded row.

trial_star_excluded.description: True if any planned star of the trial was incorrect, unanswered, answered faster than 250 ms, or has no recorded row. False for conditions without stars. Computed per trial, so it cannot collide across conditions.

star_correct_all.description: True if every planned star of the trial has a recorded row and was answered correctly (accuracy only: the 250 ms anticipatory rule is not applied). False if any star was incorrect, unanswered or has no recorded row; NA for conditions without stars. Nothing is filtered on it. Use it for the star-contingent SENSITIVITY analysis of memory accuracy; the primary analysis uses all trials.

n_probes_no_response.description: Probes with no response (recorded rows only).

n_probes_missing_row.description: Planned probes with no recorded row.

plan_source.description: trial_spec when the runtime plan was recorded on the encoding row; null otherwise.

trial_guard_excluded.description: True if a display-guard event (zoom change, fullscreen loss, tab hidden, ...) was flagged on any row of the trial. This is the flag for the pre-registered guard exclusion.

debug_reveal_seen.description: True if the experimenter secret grid reveal (G G, src/debug/reveal.js) was switched on at any time during the trial, so the answers were visible. Exclude such trials. Separate from trial_guard_excluded, which stays about display guards.

guard_flags.description: Display-guard events recorded since the previous trial, comma separated. Empty if none.

guard_n.description: Number of display-guard events behind guard_flags.

user_gain.description: Playback gain set by the participant at the volume check, 0-1.

gate_passed_at_ms.description: Time from gate onset to both arrow keys being down, ms.

gate_onset_ms.description: Trial-start gate onset relative to encoding onset, ms (negative).

pattern_onset_ms.description: Pattern reminder onset relative to encoding onset, ms. Empty if none.

arrow_cue_onset_ms.description: Rotation arrow cue onset relative to encoding onset, ms. Imagery conditions.

imagination_onset_ms.description: Imagination period onset relative to encoding onset, ms. Imagery conditions.

rotation_start_ms.description: Start of the rotation animation relative to encoding onset, ms.

retention_onset_ms.description: Retention interval onset relative to encoding onset, ms.

iti_onset_ms.description: Inter-trial interval onset relative to encoding onset, ms.

planned_total_ms.description: Planned length of the encoding node, ms.

n_star_rows_expected.description: Star rows the encoding node expected to write.

keys_outside_window.description: Arrow-key presses during encoding with no star window open.

n_key_log.description: Entries in the encoding key log.

key_log_overflow.description: True if the key log reached its size limit and later presses were not logged.

key_log_t0_offset_ms.description: Time base of the key log relative to encoding onset, ms.

n_tones_late.description: Tones scheduled after their planned onset.

n_tone_errors.description: Tones whose playback raised an error.

px_per_mm.description: Pixels per mm from the card calibration.

star.title: star row
star.description: One row per star. Unique key: participant_id, trial_seq_session, star_serial_position. Missing values are NA in the CSV.

participant_id.description: Participant id used in this table: a pseudonymous code ("P" + 12 hex) in the default export, never the Prolific id; the raw Prolific id only with --keep-pid. A reloaded run is suffixed __run_<run_id>.

trial_seq_session.description: Running number of trial-start gates in the session (practice included), in presentation order. Unique per participant.

star_serial_position.description: Star number among the THREE STARS of the trial, 1-3, 1-based (NOT the position among all stimuli: a star can be the 1st or the 6th stimulus). The overall position is `serial_position_overall`. Key column of stars.csv.

serial_position_overall.description: 1-based ordinal of the stimulus among ALL visible stimuli of the trial, in presentation order: dual trials (i_d, i_t) 1-6 (dots or tones and stars mixed; the first star may be 4th), single-task and imagery-only trials 1-3 (placeholders do not count). Empty for placeholders.

serial_position_in_modality.description: 1-based number among the three items of its own kind (dots, tones or stars), 1-3. In stars.csv this equals `star_serial_position`.

slot_in_stream.description: Slot in the six-slot encoding stream, 1-6, 1-based (raw slot_index_in_seq + 1; identical meaning in all five trial types and for dots, stars, tones and placeholders; planned order of the trial_spec sequence; includes invisible placeholders). In stars.csv same as `slot`.

trial_uid.description: Trial name from the runtime, e.g. main_a-007-i_d. Unique for main trials; practice names repeat when a practice pass is repeated.

attempt.description: Pass number of the trial: 1 for main trials, 1 or 2 for practice trials (practice can run twice).

condition.description: d_only, t_only, i_only, i_d or i_t.

presentation_index.description: 1-120, 1-based, over the main task in presentation order; empty in practice. Counted by the exporter.

pool_index.description: Number of the trial in the condition pool of 24, 1-24, 1-based (raw trial_index_in_block + 1; the `Trial` column of the wide files). Not unique across conditions.

rotation_deg.description: Rotation of the grid for the trial, -90..90, clockwise positive: the angle imagined in the imagery conditions and the angle the grid is shown at in d_only. Empty for t_only.

sequence.description: Six-slot sequence, M = memory-item slot, S = star slot.

slot.description: Position of the star in the six-slot encoding stream, 1-6, 1-based; same as `slot_in_stream`. In single-task trials the stream holds invisible placeholders, so this is NOT the serial position among the stimuli shown: use `serial_position_overall`.

cell.description: Cell id 0-24, row-major, a stable 0-BASED IDENTIFIER (key into src/config.js, src/grid.js and the pre-registration; cell 0 = top-left, 12 = centre), not a count. Relation to the 1-based grid position: cell = (cell_row - 1) * 5 + (cell_col - 1). Empty in encoding_events.csv rows of placeholders (see `placeholder_cell`).

cell_row.description: Row of the cell in the 5 x 5 grid, 1-5, 1-based (1 = top row, 3 = centre row); cell = (cell_row - 1) * 5 + (cell_col - 1). Raw session_info.cell_table.row is 0-based.

cell_col.description: Column of the cell in the 5 x 5 grid, 1-5, 1-based (1 = left column, 3 = centre column).

cell_x_mm.description: Cell centre x in the upright grid, mm from fixation.

cell_y_mm.description: Cell centre y in the upright grid, mm from fixation (down positive).

x_mm.description: Screen x of the stimulus after rotation, mm from fixation (x right). Empty for tones, which have no screen position, and for placeholders (invisible).

y_mm.description: Screen y of the stimulus after rotation, mm from fixation (down positive). Empty for tones and placeholders.

radius_mm.description: Distance of the cell centre from fixation, mm.

is_on_pattern.description: True if the cell is on the pattern.

row_recorded.description: False if the planned event has no row in the data.

responded.description: True if a valid key was pressed in the window.

said_on.description: True if the participant answered on-pattern.

rt_ms.description: Response time of the FIRST valid key press, ms from the onset of the same stimulus (stars.csv: star onset, `star_onset_ms`; probes.csv: onset of that probe, `probe_onset_ms`), from the key event timestamp, rounded, at least 1. A press counts only inside the 3000 ms window [onset, onset + 3000); extra presses are counted in `extra_keypresses`, presses before the onset in `early_keypresses`, after the window in `late_keypresses`. Empty when not answered (then `responded` is false); rows that were not recorded have row_recorded = false.

excluded_anticipatory.description: True if the response was given and rt_ms < 250 ms (anticipation floor, RT_FLOOR_MS). Not applied to the data: it is a flag.

star_onset_ms.description: Star onset (animation-frame time of the first frame with the star) relative to encoding onset, ms. Equals `onset_ms` of the star slot in encoding_events.csv.

star_offset_ms.description: Star offset relative to encoding onset, ms: frame time of the first frame without the star (raw slot_offsets_ts_ms of the star slot; the star row itself is written at the removal call, see `window_closed_ms`). Empty if the star was cut short by the end of the node (truncated) or never drawn. `star_offset_ms - star_onset_ms` is the time the star was on screen (about 3000 ms).

response_ms.description: Time of the first valid key press relative to encoding onset, ms (the key event timestamp: raw response_ts_ms minus encoding_onset_ts_ms). Empty if not answered. `rt_ms` = `response_ms` minus the onset of the same table (`star_onset_ms` in stars.csv, `probe_onset_ms` in probes.csv) up to the 1 ms rounding of the two timestamps (rt_ms is rounded from the unrounded difference and is at least 1).

trial_star_excluded.description: True if any planned star of the trial was incorrect, unanswered, answered faster than 250 ms, or has no recorded row. False for conditions without stars. Computed per trial, so it cannot collide across conditions.

star_correct_all.description: True if every planned star of the trial has a recorded row and was answered correctly (accuracy only: the 250 ms anticipatory rule is not applied). False if any star was incorrect, unanswered or has no recorded row; NA for conditions without stars. Nothing is filtered on it. Use it for the star-contingent SENSITIVITY analysis of memory accuracy; the primary analysis uses all trials.

position_matches_runtime.description: True if the exporter position equals the position logged at runtime; empty if none was logged.

early_keypresses.description: Valid keys pressed before the window opened.

late_keypresses.description: Valid keys pressed after the window closed.

extra_keypresses.description: Valid keys pressed after the first response in the window.

star_onset_lag_ms.description: Star onset minus its planned onset, ms.

window_closed_ms.description: Time the star window closed relative to encoding onset, ms.

displayed.description: True if the star was drawn.

truncated.description: True if the window was cut short when the node ended.

guard_flags.description: Display-guard events recorded since the previous trial, comma separated. Empty if none.

guard_n.description: Number of display-guard events behind guard_flags.

user_gain.description: Playback gain set by the participant at the volume check, 0-1.

trial_guard_excluded.description: True if a display-guard event (zoom change, fullscreen loss, tab hidden, ...) was flagged on any row of the trial. This is the flag for the pre-registered guard exclusion.

debug_reveal_seen.description: True if the experimenter secret grid reveal (G G, src/debug/reveal.js) was switched on at any time during the trial, so the answers were visible. Exclude such trials. Separate from trial_guard_excluded, which stays about display guards.

px_per_mm.description: Pixels per mm from the card calibration.

participant_id.description: Participant id used in this table: a pseudonymous code ("P" + 12 hex) in the default export, never the Prolific id; the raw Prolific id only with --keep-pid. A reloaded run is suffixed __run_<run_id>.

trial_seq_session.description: Running number of trial-start gates in the session (practice included), in presentation order. Unique per participant.

probe_position.description: Test position: the order of this recognition test within the trial, 1-3, 1-based. Random with respect to the encoding order. Key column of probes.csv.

trial_uid.description: Trial name from the runtime, e.g. main_a-007-i_d. Unique for main trials; practice names repeat when a practice pass is repeated.

attempt.description: Pass number of the trial: 1 for main trials, 1 or 2 for practice trials (practice can run twice).

sequence.description: Six-slot sequence, M = memory-item slot, S = star slot.

is_target.description: True if the probe matches an encoded item.

cell.description: Cell id 0-24, row-major, a stable 0-BASED IDENTIFIER (key into src/config.js, src/grid.js and the pre-registration; cell 0 = top-left, 12 = centre), not a count. Relation to the 1-based grid position: cell = (cell_row - 1) * 5 + (cell_col - 1). Empty in encoding_events.csv rows of placeholders (see `placeholder_cell`).

cell_row.description: Row of the cell in the 5 x 5 grid, 1-5, 1-based (1 = top row, 3 = centre row); cell = (cell_row - 1) * 5 + (cell_col - 1). Raw session_info.cell_table.row is 0-based.

cell_col.description: Column of the cell in the 5 x 5 grid, 1-5, 1-based (1 = left column, 3 = centre column).

cell_x_mm.description: Cell centre x in the upright grid, mm from fixation.

cell_y_mm.description: Cell centre y in the upright grid, mm from fixation (down positive).

probe_frame_rotation_deg.description: Rotation of the frame the probe was drawn in (0 = upright).

x_mm.description: Screen x of the stimulus after rotation, mm from fixation (x right). Empty for tones, which have no screen position, and for placeholders (invisible).

y_mm.description: Screen y of the stimulus after rotation, mm from fixation (down positive). Empty for tones and placeholders.

radius_mm.description: Distance of the cell centre from fixation, mm.

encoding_position.description: 1-based (1-3) number of the encoded item (among the three items of the SAME modality) that the probe is built from. For a target it is the number of the encoded item; for a foil it is a DESIGN LABEL only (the item the foil was generated against): never use it as a serial position of a foil. It is not the test position (`probe_position`) and not the serial position among all stimuli (`target_serial_position_overall`).

target_slot.description: Slot (1-6, 1-based) of the probed item in the six-slot encoding stream; same as `target_slot_in_stream`; empty for foils. Not the serial position among visible stimuli in single-task trials (placeholders occupy slots): use `target_serial_position_overall`.

test_position.description: 1-based (1-3) position of the recognition test in the test phase; equals `probe_position`. In events rows: the test position of the target probe that tests this item (empty if no probe tests the item, always empty for stars and placeholders).

target_serial_position_overall.description: For a TARGET probe: the encoding serial position (1-based) of the probed item among ALL visible stimuli of the trial (dual 1-6, single 1-3). Empty for foils.

target_serial_position_in_modality.description: For a target probe: number (1-3) of the probed item among the three encoded items of its kind. Empty for foils. Equals `encoding_position` for targets.

target_slot_in_stream.description: For a target probe: slot (1-6, 1-based) in the six-slot stream of the probed item; join to encoding_events.csv on (participant_id, trial_seq_session, slot_in_stream). Empty for foils.

target_event_key.description: For a target probe: "participant_id|trial_seq_session|slot_in_stream" of the encoding event that this probe tests (the key of encoding_events.csv). Empty for foils.

enc1_cell.description: Cell of the item encoded first.

enc1_pattern_label.description: on or off label of the first item.

enc1_x_mm.description: Screen x of the first encoded dot (rotated), mm. Dot conditions only.

enc1_y_mm.description: Screen y of the first encoded dot (rotated), mm.

enc2_cell.description: Cell of the item encoded second.

enc2_pattern_label.description: on or off label of the second item.

enc2_x_mm.description: Screen x of the second encoded dot, mm.

enc2_y_mm.description: Screen y of the second encoded dot, mm.

enc3_cell.description: Cell of the item encoded third.

enc3_pattern_label.description: on or off label of the third item.

enc3_x_mm.description: Screen x of the third encoded dot, mm.

enc3_y_mm.description: Screen y of the third encoded dot, mm.

min_enc_dist_mm.description: Smallest distance between the probe screen position and the screen positions of the encoded dots, mm. Dot conditions only.

nearest_enc_position.description: Encoding position (1-3, 1-based, among the three encoded dots) of the encoded dot nearest to the probe on screen.

own_enc_dist_mm.description: For a target: distance between the probe and its own encoded dot on screen, mm (0 when the probe frame and encoding frame have the same rotation).

tone_index.description: Tone id 0-23, a stable 0-BASED IDENTIFIER (index in the 24-tone bank of src/audio/tones.js; the pre-registered rank is tone_index + 1), not a count. Tone conditions only.

tone_freq_hz.description: Frequency of the probe tone, Hz.

min_tone_rank_gap.description: Smallest rank distance between the probe tone and the encoded tones.

row_recorded.description: False if the planned event has no row in the data.

responded.description: True if a valid key was pressed in the window.

said_yes.description: True if the participant answered yes.

rt_ms.description: Response time of the FIRST valid key press, ms from the onset of the same stimulus (stars.csv: star onset, `star_onset_ms`; probes.csv: onset of that probe, `probe_onset_ms`), from the key event timestamp, rounded, at least 1. A press counts only inside the 3000 ms window [onset, onset + 3000); extra presses are counted in `extra_keypresses`, presses before the onset in `early_keypresses`, after the window in `late_keypresses`. Empty when not answered (then `responded` is false); rows that were not recorded have row_recorded = false.

excluded_anticipatory.description: True if the response was given and rt_ms < 250 ms (anticipation floor, RT_FLOOR_MS). Not applied to the data: it is a flag.

probe_onset_ms.description: Probe onset (animation-frame time of the first frame of the probe node) relative to encoding onset, ms; the origin of `rt_ms`.

response_ms.description: Time of the first valid key press relative to encoding onset, ms (the key event timestamp: raw response_ts_ms minus encoding_onset_ts_ms). Empty if not answered. `rt_ms` = `response_ms` minus the onset of the same table (`star_onset_ms` in stars.csv, `probe_onset_ms` in probes.csv) up to the 1 ms rounding of the two timestamps (rt_ms is rounded from the unrounded difference and is at least 1).

False if any star was incorrect, unanswered or has no recorded row; NA for conditions without stars. Nothing is filtered on it. Use it for the star-contingent SENSITIVITY analysis of memory accuracy; the primary analysis uses all trials.

late_keypresses.description: Valid keys pressed after the window closed.

guard_n.description: Number of display-guard events behind guard_flags.

user_gain.description: Playback gain set by the participant at the volume check, 0-1.

audio_output_latency_ms.description: Reported audio output latency plus base latency, ms.

audio_context_time_at_onset_ms.description: AudioContext currentTime at probe onset, ms.

tone_error.description: True if playback of this tone raised an error (slot_tone_events.error). In probes.csv: the probe tone.

trial_guard_excluded.description: True if a display-guard event (zoom change, fullscreen loss, tab hidden, ...) was flagged on any row of the trial. This is the flag for the pre-registered guard exclusion.

debug_reveal_seen.description: True if the experimenter secret grid reveal (G G, src/debug/reveal.js) was switched on at any time during the trial, so the answers were visible. Exclude such trials. Separate from trial_guard_excluded, which stays about display guards.

radius_mm.description: Distance of the cell centre from fixation, mm.

is_on_pattern.description: True if the cell is on the pattern.

tone_index.description: Tone id 0-23, a stable 0-BASED IDENTIFIER (index in the 24-tone bank of src/audio/tones.js; the pre-registered rank is tone_index + 1), not a count. Tone conditions only.

tone_freq_hz.description: Frequency of the probe tone, Hz.

onset_ms.description: Onset of the slot relative to encoding onset (the moment the grid was mounted, performance.now() scale), ms. Source in `onset_source`: tones are the PLANNED onset (the tone is scheduled ahead on the audio clock; the actual onset is not measured), dots and placeholders the animation-frame time of drawing, stars the onset logged on the star row. Placeholders are invisible: the row records when the (invisible) slot element was added.

onset_source.description: tone_planned (planned onset of the scheduled tone: scheduled, NOT measured), star_row_frame (onset of the star row), or slot_frame (frame timestamp of the slot in slot_onsets_ts_ms).

offset_ms.description: Offset of the slot relative to encoding onset, ms, on the same scale as `onset_ms`: the frame time of the first frame without the element (dots, stars and placeholders; source in `offset_source`), or for a tone the planned onset plus the nominal tone duration (350 ms; scheduled, NOT measured). Empty if the event never happened or was still running when the node was cut short.

offset_source.description: frame (first animation frame without the element), removal_call (time of the removal call: no frame arrived before the node ended), scheduled (tone: planned onset + nominal duration, not measured), aborted (the node was cut short while the event was running: no offset), or empty (no event / no offset recorded, e.g. data from before offsets were recorded).

duration_ms.description: Actual duration of the event, ms: `offset_ms - onset_ms`. For a placeholder it is the length of the invisible placeholder element, which only stands for the event it replaces (nothing was presented). Tones: the nominal duration (scheduled, not measured). Empty if either time is missing.

planned_onset_ms.description: Planned onset relative to encoding onset, ms: raw slot_planned_onsets_ts_ms (plan origin t0 + planned time; t0 is taken inside the encoding node less than a millisecond after encoding onset), else from the plan constants (1500 ms pre-encoding pad, then 1500 ms per M slot and 3500 ms per S slot).

planned_offset_ms.description: Planned offset relative to encoding onset, ms: planned onset plus the planned duration (dots and placeholders in M slots 1000 ms, stars and placeholders in S slots 3000 ms, tones 350 ms).

onset_error_ms.description: Actual minus planned onset, ms (`onset_ms - planned_onset_ms`). Tones: always 0 or about 0, because the recorded onset of a tone IS the planned one.

offset_error_ms.description: Actual minus planned offset, ms (`offset_ms - planned_offset_ms`). Tones: always about 0 (scheduled offset).

silence_before_ms.description: Time with nothing perceptible (no dot, star or tone) before this slot, ms: `onset_ms` of this slot minus the offset of the previous PERCEPTIBLE event (dots, stars, tones; invisible placeholders are not perceptible, so a placeholder interval counts as silence). For the first perceptible event, and for placeholders before any perceptible event, it is measured from the start of the encoding phase (encoding onset, time 0, which includes the 1500 ms pre-encoding pad) (`silence_before_ref` = encoding_start). For a placeholder row it is the silence from the previous perceptible event to the start of this placeholder.

silence_before_ref.description: Reference of `silence_before_ms`: previous_event_offset (offset of the previous perceptible event) or encoding_start (no perceptible event before this slot: time 0 = encoding onset).

silence_after_ms.description: Time with nothing perceptible after this slot, ms: onset of the next PERCEPTIBLE event minus `offset_ms` of this slot (placeholders in between count as silence). Empty for the last perceptible event of the trial (nothing follows inside the encoding phase) and where a time is missing. For a placeholder row it is the silence from the end of this placeholder to the next perceptible event.

onset_gap_ms.description: onset_ms minus onset_ms of the previous slot (slot_in_stream - 1, placeholders included), ms: the slot-to-slot onset interval (1500 after a memory slot, 3500 after a star slot). Empty for slot 1 and where an onset is missing.

tone_planned_onset_ms.description: Planned onset of the tone relative to encoding onset, ms (slot_tone_events.planned_ts_ms). Tones only.

tone_scheduled_onset_ms.description: Onset scheduled on the AudioContext clock converted to the performance clock, relative to encoding onset, ms (scheduled_onset_perf_ms). Empty when the browser gave no timing. This is the best available estimate of the real tone onset; the real onset is not measured.

tone_scheduled_offset_ms.description: Scheduled device offset of the tone relative to encoding onset, ms: `tone_scheduled_onset_ms` plus the nominal duration (scheduled_offset_perf_ms). Empty when the browser gave no timing. Tones only; not measured.

tone_event_recorded.description: True if the runtime wrote a tone event for this slot. Tones only.

tone_late.description: True if the tone was scheduled after its planned onset (slot_tone_events.late). Tones only.

tone_late_ms.description: How late the tone was scheduled, ms (slot_tone_events.late_ms). Tones only.

tone_error.description: True if playback of this tone raised an error (slot_tone_events.error). In probes.csv: the probe tone.

tested_later.description: For dots and tones: True if one of the three recognition tests is a TARGET probe of this item, False if no test probes it (a trial has 0 to 3 target probes, so a trial may test none, some or all of its items). Empty for stars and placeholders and when no probes were planned.

test_position.description: 1-based (1-3) position of the recognition test in the test phase; equals `probe_position`. In events rows: the test position of the target probe that tests this item (empty if no probe tests the item, always empty for stars and placeholders).

test_probe_type.description: T_on, T_off, F_on or F_off of the target probe that tests this item.

test_row_recorded.description: False if the planned test has no row in the data.

test_responded.description: True if the test of this item was answered.

test_said_yes.description: True if the participant answered yes to the test of this item.

test_correct.description: True if the test of this item (a target) was answered correctly, i.e. yes.

test_rt_ms.description: Response time of the test of this item (the target probe of this item), ms from that probe own onset: `rt_ms` of the joined row of probes.csv. Empty if the item was not tested or the test was not answered (test_responded false). Foil probes have no item and appear only in probes.csv.

test_excluded_anticipatory.description: True if the test was answered and test_rt_ms < 250 (flag only).

star_row_recorded.description: False if the planned star has no row in the data.

star_responded.description: True if a valid key was pressed in the star window.

star_said_on.description: True if the participant answered on-pattern.

star_rt_ms.description: Star response time, ms from star onset.

star_onset_lag_ms.description: Star onset minus its planned onset, ms.

star_window_closed_ms.description: Time the star window closed relative to encoding onset, ms (same as window_closed_ms in stars.csv).

star_displayed.description: True if the star was drawn.

star_truncated.description: True if the star window was cut short when the node ended.

position_matches_runtime.description: True if the exporter position equals the position logged at runtime; empty if none was logged.

trial_star_excluded.description: True if any planned star of the trial was incorrect, unanswered, answered faster than 250 ms, or has no recorded row. False for conditions without stars. Computed per trial, so it cannot collide across conditions.

trial_guard_excluded.description: True if a display-guard event (zoom change, fullscreen loss, tab hidden, ...) was flagged on any row of the trial. This is the flag for the pre-registered guard exclusion.

debug_reveal_seen.description: True if the experimenter secret grid reveal (G G, src/debug/reveal.js) was switched on at any time during the trial, so the answers were visible. Exclude such trials. Separate from trial_guard_excluded, which stays about display guards.

px_per_mm.description: Pixels per mm from the card calibration.
